name: Prinny
source: A normal Prinny, just like every other Prinnies of the underworld. It works for Prince Laharl at Laharl's castle. But due to some circumstances, the Prinny finds itself working for free to its dismay. Later, the Prinny finds a pocket watch that allows it to travel back in time, but also possess others at will. Now it uses its power to go back in time to interact with the various denizens of the underworld to change this Prinny's fate.
